change_summary: Keep one coherent standalone Markdown source useful as a single reader Page while preserving exact bytes, and stop fresh-host suites after a structured provider capacity rejection.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.8 keeps coherent standalone Markdown useful as one reader Page while preserving exact source bytes and the raw-only boundary.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; the server advertises Skill and Plugin 1.7.8 without widening authority or changing MCP schemas.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.8 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.8.

package_setup.note: The existing bounded session hook remains compatible; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host harness preserves structured provider capacity blockers, circuit-breaks redundant queued attempts, and keeps the 30 by 2 matrix plus lean single-reader semantic boundary unchanged.

external_marketplaces.note: Anthropic, WorkBuddy, and other account-owned listing or fresh-host acceptance remains pending until external receipts exist.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers provider-capacity parsing/circuit breaking, Skill/package identity, coherent single-reader guidance, and fresh Codex plus Claude Code behavior against the live MCP.
